Use a dreamy pastel sky at sunrise or sunset with soft blue, pink, peach, and lavender clouds, intense backlighting, sparkling highlights, lens flare, translucent glass reflections, and a sense of wind moving her hair, ribbons, and sleeves. Composition should feel cinematic and high-angle, with large blurred clock rims in the foreground for depth, a huge detailed clock face in the upper right, and intricate clockwork beneath her feet. Style: highly detailed modern Japanese anime art, ethereal, elegant, magical, clean linework, luminous whites and golds, delicate rendering, soft bokeh, volumetric light, ultra polished fantasy illustration. Constraints: no text, no watermark, no extra characters, keep the image bright and airy, emphasize the theme The Administrator of Time.
